context_requirements: Functional bile-acid/farnesoid-X-receptor or bile-salt-export physiology, which is not represented in the nine non-hepatic cancer lines
Hepatic or intestinal lineage with intact bile-acid synthesis/transport machinery; HEPG2 and HT29 are only partial models and are not expected to show a specific transcriptional signature at 10 µM
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional signature shared across multiple lines at 6 h or 24 h
Coordinate induction of bile-acid synthesis or transport genes (e.g., NR1H4/FXR targets, ABCB11, SLC10A1) in any line
Consistent changes in cholesterol/bile-acid pathway landmark genes such as HMGCR, HMGCS1, FDFT1, or NR1H2
